alt: A breakfast table set for five in front of a tall glass wall, with a sunlit street and the land rising beyond.
A tree-lined street in the Arbor Quarter with a tram shelter, and the city curving up into the distance overhead.
A metro platform 46 m above the street, looking along an elevated viaduct with the train set waiting at the platform.
A wide plaza at the foot of the ascender tower, with a ring sculpture and the boarding lift entrance.
The boarding deck of the Arbor ascender tower, with the family at the rail and a bronze lattice tower beyond.
An ascender cabin rises through the open floor of the artificial sky, with the opposite city and a lit ceiling stretching away.
A grow gallery with stacked racks of lettuce, basil and kale under white and magenta lights, and a harvest gantry overhead.
The rotating transfer hub at the top of the ascender, with the stationary spine beyond the glass and no floor in sight.
A bearing gallery where two large hubs face each other across a narrow gap, with momentum rings in the distance.
A 700 m spacecraft held by tension lines inside a vast dark construction volume, with robot arms and tugs at work.
Wheel D, the departures wheel: travellers and cafe tables on a street that curves up into the vault in Earth gravity.
The passenger cabin before launch, with rows of couches, a window band and the long launch track running ahead.
Midcourse, two days out: the Concordia shuttle coasting toward a small, distant Earth crescent.
Earth as a small blue disc against fixed stars, seen from the departing stack on its way home.
Earth filling the window as the stack falls toward a low perigee, with clouds and coastlines below.
